Prints a documentation page from the copy built into this binary.

With no topic, lists every page by section. A topic is a page's path — `concepts/state` — or just its last part where that is unambiguous, so `kx docs top` reaches the reference page for `kx top`.

A topic that names no page is searched for instead, and the closest pages are listed. 'state' names two, a concept and a command, so both are offered rather than one of them chosen.

The pages describe the kx that is printing them, not the current website: they are built into the binary, so they work offline and never describe a flag this version does not have. `kx <command> --help` remains the shorter answer for one command's flags.

## Usage

```text
kx docs [OPTIONS] [topic]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `[topic]` | Documentation page: its path, or its last part — kx docs lists them |

## Global options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--no-color` | Disable styled output |
| `-h, --help` | Show this message and exit |

## Examples

```bash
kx docs
kx docs top
kx docs concepts/state
kx docs marks
```
